findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "quantgeeks_get_readings" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: symbol, date, at, time, metric, history, detail

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "quantgeeks_read_the_board" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Without signing in: a basic six-step workflow for reading a symbol's board with these tools. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: a basic six-step workflow…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
